name: Third, independent benchmark: frozen AnchorBoost on human neural cells (US EPA DNT screen)
question: Does the frozen forecaster, with no change and no choice made on new data, beat the strongest sparse-concentration baselines on a third public dose-response screen run in human neural progenitors and human neurons?

source.record: US EPA ScienceHub, DOI 10.23719/1407642 (Harrill et al. 2018, Toxicology and Applied Pharmacology 354:24-39)

data.design: Every endpoint the file records in human cells: hNP1 neural progenitors (caspase apoptosis, CellTiter viability, three proliferation readouts: object count, percent responders, mean intensity) and hN2 neurons (high-content neurite outgrowth: neuron count, neurite length, neurite count, branch points). Up to 11 concentrations per chemical on three replicate plates. Endpoints are selected by the assay component name prefix hNP1_ or hN2_.
data.preparation: Rows flagged well quality 0 are removed (79 of 21,372 human-cell rows) and rows without a raw value are dropped (6). Each plate is centred on the median of its vehicle wells (well type n), each endpoint is divided by 1.4826 x the median absolute centred vehicle value over all its plates (the vehicle SD where that is zero) and clipped to +-10: the acute MEA benchmark's normalization, unchanged.
data.wells: A well is one plate position for one sample, because plate IDs DNT0201-E1 to E3 each hold two chemicals at the same positions in the source file; endpoints read from the same well share a row, the others are masked. 8,061 test wells.
data.tasks: 71 chemicals with at least one human-cell endpoint (61 with 11 concentrations, 5 with 10, 4 with 9, 1 with 7), 9 outputs at one read time, concentrations grouped per chemical on a 0.1 log10 grid. Sample names are used as given (Valproate and Valproic Acid are two samples).
data.folds: fold = int(sha256('dnt-hci|' + sample name)[:8], 16) mod 5; 12/17/14/13/15 chemicals
data.independence: Different species and cells (human neural progenitors and neurons, not rat cortical networks), different readouts (high-content imaging and plate-reader assays, not electrophysiology); nothing from the developmental or acute MEA benchmarks enters training or evaluation.

checks_before_freeze.note: baseline-only computation; no AnchorBoost model was trained on these data before this freeze

model.configuration: frozen F101 AnchorBoost, every C(L,3) design of every training chemical, unchanged features and hyperparameters

evaluation.metric: curve error against held-out concentration means, averaged over observed outputs, designs and then chemicals
evaluation.per_fold: fold means of every method and the paired difference against log-linear interpolation within each fold

pass_rule: AnchorBoost minus log-linear interpolation over all 71 chemicals: 95% chemical-bootstrap upper bound below zero
reporting: The result is published whatever its sign. A failed pass rule is reported with its numbers and is not followed by any change of preparation, endpoints, model or rule on these data.
